notes:
### The stray bar in the corner is gone

Windows only, non-maximized: a thin vertical bar used to appear at the very top-left of the window, over the sidebar. That was Elbiko drawing its own scroll bar — a leftover from the old design that never had a position set, so it landed in the corner. It has been removed; scrolling uses the normal Windows scroll bar, which also works when the window is maximized.

Everything else in 3.0.0 is unchanged: your data, settings and the new look all stay exactly as they are.
